CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid apps and plugins by sognix. Video2X WebGUI (Docker): web interface for Video2X, AI upscaling and frame interpolation of videos on your GPUs - support via https://github.com/sognix/video2x-webgui/issues. Swap Manager (plugin): create and manage a swapfile or ZFS zvol from the WebUI, with autostart, automatic swapoff before the array stop and an optional usage history - support via https://github.com/sognix/unraid-swap-manager/issues.
